parrafo.es: LuckyDawg Ink es un estudio de tatuajes en Plant City donde Dawg trabaja piezas personalizadas, cover ups y mangas completas, con un ambiente relajado y limpio.
parrafo.en: LuckyDawg Ink is a Plant City tattoo shop where Dawg works custom pieces, cover ups and full sleeves, in a clean, laid back shop.

hero.imagen_alt: Manga de antebrazo con calavera de picas en llamas, dados y cartas, tatuaje de LuckyDawg Ink

parrafo_1.es: LuckyDawg Ink trabaja en Plant City, FL desde su estudio en S Alexander St. Dawg hace tatuajes personalizados, cover ups y mangas completas, con un trato cercano y un taller limpio.
parrafo_1.en: LuckyDawg Ink works out of Plant City, FL from the shop on S Alexander St. Dawg does custom tattoos, cover ups and full sleeves, with a friendly approach and a clean studio.

parrafo_2.es: El resultado habla solo: 4.6 estrellas en Google con 30 reseñas, y clientes que vuelven pieza tras pieza.
parrafo_2.en: The result speaks for itself: 4.6 stars on Google across 30 reviews, with clients coming back piece after piece.

texto.es: Nos cuentas la idea, el tamaño y la zona del cuerpo por teléfono o pasando por el estudio.
texto.en: Tell us the idea, size and placement by phone or by stopping by the shop.

texto.es: Dawg te da el precio segun el diseño, sin sorpresas.
texto.en: Dawg gives you the price based on the design, no surprises.

texto.es: Trabajo limpio y a tu ritmo, en un estudio tranquilo.
texto.en: Clean work at your pace, in a relaxed shop.

texto.es: Te explicamos como cuidar tu tatuaje para que cicatrice bien.
texto.en: We walk you through aftercare so your tattoo heals right.

nota.es: Cada tatuaje se cotiza segun el diseño y el tamaño. Llamanos y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every tattoo is quoted based on the design and size. Call us and we will give you the price, no strings attached.

texto.es: Diseños propios hechos a tu medida, de piezas pequenas a mangas completas.
texto.en: Original designs made to fit you, from small pieces to full sleeves.

texto.es: Transformamos tatuajes viejos en piezas nuevas que si quieres mostrar.
texto.en: We turn old tattoos into new pieces you actually want to show off.

texto.es: Proyectos de varias sesiones para brazo, pierna o espalda completa.
texto.en: Multi-session projects for a full arm, leg or back piece.

texto.es: Pasas por el estudio y vemos que podemos hacer el mismo dia.
texto.en: Stop by the shop and we will see what we can do same day.

pie.es: ¿Tienes una idea distinta? Llámanos igual, seguro podemos ayudarte.
pie.en: Have a different idea? Call us anyway, we can probably help.

items.quote: Went in for an update on one tattoo and a whole new tattoo. Both look awesome and the best prices in town. Will definitely be going back for my next tattoo. Highly recommend!
Dawg is an amazing artist and enjoyable to be around for hours. Great prices, clean studio. Can't wait to get the rest of my arm done!
Dawg is absolutely amazing!!! I come out falling in love with my tattoo more and more every time. He is such an amazing artist and you come out with masterpieces that are one of a kind.
